lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice making suggestions with Ska vi and kan.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues decide what to do for lunch or after work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Suggesting, accepting, and choosing between simple options.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether to take lunch outside, go for a walk, or stay near the office.

main_focus.name: making suggestions with Ska vi
main_focus.description: Use Ska vi plus infinitive to suggest a shared activity and kan to offer alternatives.
model_examples: Vi kan ta en promenad först.
Ska vi kanske gå till det nya caféet?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use suggestion forms naturally 4-6 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use suggestion and response chunks that make the dialogue action-oriented.

dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two simple options and respond politely.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on one concrete plan.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat suggestion patterns while varying the activity

focus: which option is preferred and why

sentence_focus: one question starting with Ska vi
one sentence offering an option with Vi kan
one sentence politely declining or limiting an option
one sentence with the agreed lunch or after-work plan
